canonical_forecast_presim.bottleneck: best-ball presim re-derived slot eligibility on every one of ~1440 lineup solves; cProfile: 17.9 s of 23.3 s in _player_eligible_for_slot (2,020,710 calls)

productionReproduction.method: read-only curl of public endpoints from a Windows client (RTT floor ~0.35 s)
productionReproduction.observed: first rosPlayoffOdds / rosChampionship request after each ~5 min public snapshot refresh took 10.35 s, 11.52 s, 13.15 s, 11.18 s; same endpoints warm 0.36-0.43 s; payload forecastCached=false
productionReproduction.why_live: data/ros/sims/latest_playoff.json is fresh in git but production's copy is older than the 6 h mtime TTL: data-only refresh deploys are paths-ignored and the 08:29 UTC dispatch deploy failed its hard gate (tests/market_trades/test_own_league_census.py, tests/api/test_pick_refinement.py), so the live presim runs once per snapshot generation

functionLevel.harness: simulate_playoff_odds(snapshot, rng=random.Random(12345)) on a real dynasty_main snapshot (built 2026-10-27T11:11:59Z), 3 sequential runs

serverLevel.harness: uvicorn server:app (local, E2E mode), sims files aged past TTL to force the live path; per run: restart, settle 25 s, GET overview, time first GET /api/public/league/rosPlayoffOdds

league_tab_switch.bottleneck: on a tab click the section chunk was requested only after its data landed, and the React.lazy boundary inside next/dynamic then suspended once and React throttled the reveal (~300 ms) even with data and code present
league_tab_switch.productionTrace: Records click: data 12-458 ms, chunk 461-595 ms, content 791 ms (desktop, unthrottled, one trace)

localObserver.harness: in-page MutationObserver + ResourceTiming, local production build, tab click from Overview

localSpaHarness.harness: fresh context per run, /league?tab=overview then click 8 tabs, click -> panel text without 'Loading', CDP latency 150 ms

measuredOnly.one_off: a single 57.76 s GET /api/public/league/overview at ~11:32 UTC did not recur in 30 polls over 11 minutes; cause not established
measuredOnly.team_strength: anonymous ?tab=rosTeamStrength reaches its terminal state in ~1.75 s cold (production); the section is session-gated (PRIVATE_INTELLIGENCE_SECTIONS) and shows 'ROS roster strength unavailable HTTP 401' to anonymous visitors. No indefinite loading reproduced (#1340).
measuredOnly.trade_calculator_local: measure-trade-interaction.mjs n=5: search p95 17.7/18.1 ms, immediate verdict p95 16.5/11.9 ms, Final Decision p95 805.6/806.6 ms (700 ms debounce + analyze), desktop/mobile
measuredOnly.rankings_local: route baseline cold p95 1008 ms desktop / 761 ms mobile; search p95 33.5 ms and position filter p95 50.2 ms at 1x CPU, 217/516 ms at 4x CPU (desktop); no dominant JS hotspot in a CDP profile
measuredOnly.player_file_local: row click -> profile dialog p50 80 ms (1x), 404 ms (4x)
measuredOnly.waivers_local: page renders in ~0.6 s; bid desk needs a selected team, not measured end to end

limitations: local Windows machine, unthrottled Chromium unless stated; bounded samples, not tail percentiles
no authenticated production measurement (no sign-in); production impact is an expectation until deployed and re-measured with the same harnesses
the dev Next bridge for /api/public/league/[section] does not forward cookies, so private sections 401 locally even when signed in; production nginx routes /api directly
